name: Familiar Friend

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Find Familiar is always prepared, with one free casting per Long Rest; your familiar is tougher, and while it's beside you it gives you Advantage on checks with skills you're proficient in, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Find Familiar
benefits.summary: Find Familiar is always prepared; pick Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma as its spellcasting ability.
benefits.text: You always have Find Familiar prepared. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma as your spellcasting ability for it.

benefits.name: Faithful Companion
benefits.summary: Once per Long Rest, cast Find Familiar without a spell slot or its incense.
benefits.text: Once per Long Rest you can cast Find Familiar without spending a spell slot or the incense it would consume. (Cast as a Ritual from the character sheet it costs nothing anyway; a fight that casts it ahead with a slot uses this free casting first.)

benefits.name: Fortified Familiar
benefits.summary: Your familiar's current and maximum Hit Points rise by twice your character level.
benefits.text: Whenever you cast Find Familiar, the familiar gains current and maximum Hit Points equal to twice your character level.

benefits.name: Helpful Friend
benefits.summary: With your familiar within 5 feet, Advantage on a check with a skill you're proficient in. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.
benefits.text: While your familiar is within 5 feet of you, you can give yourself Advantage on an ability check that uses a skill you're proficient in. You can do so a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain every use when you finish a Long Rest. It's used on its own on such a check (in a fight you can turn it Off in the class tab); outside a fight your familiar is taken to be at your side. It never applies to a check already failed.
benefits.policy_cost: One use (Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest)
